'''Lady Aros''' was a [[Hapes/Legends|Hapan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the lady-in-waiting to the [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She was present during the kidnapping of [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] by [[Darth Caedus]].
